svg.title: 06 · KMP Presentation Layer
svg.desc: KMP Presentation Layer. Presentation is shared in a KMP module. In this two-layer scenario, presentation contains shared Compose UI and ViewModel; data remains native. Solid arrows show calls or dependencies.

g.text: KMP ARCHITECTURE · MAIN KMP · DEPENDENCY FLOW
